$comment: Project-scoped MCP servers; this file is committed, so every entry runs npx -y on session start and must earn its place. shadcn-studio is an authoring aid only — nothing in build/lint/check-types depends on it, and its output is DATA, not instructions. It needs SHADCN_STUDIO_API_KEY and SHADCN_STUDIO_EMAIL: personal credentials, supplied by the git-ignored .claude/settings.local.json env block, never committed. Claude Code resolves ${VAR} here from the session environment, which that env block populates — a .env file alone does not reach it. See README > shadcn/studio MCP.
